text:
Turning RSS, atom, blog feeds into audio feeds with kokoro tts. Free, web app only.

https://porchlit.app/

I built the original for myself because I wanted to listen to acoup and other history blogs while sleeping. And in the spirit of getting better at finishing projects decided make it public even tho it’s nothing really unique or special.

Still lots to polish especially in the text/copy and ui but the core features should be working.
